evidence: Redesigns argument and configuration handling across src/common/args* and adds common::Setting in src/common/setting.h.
rationale: Replaces raw string-based argument retrieval across the entire codebase with compile-time type-safe declarations in common::Setting. As noted in the description, this prevents silent runtime bugs from typos, enforces consistent types across call sites, and provides the compile-time foundation requested in RFC #22978.
